summary: This document specifies the preferred method for carrying Delay- and Disruption-Tolerant Networking (DTN) data over the Internet using datagrams. It covers convergence layers for the Bundle Protocol (RFC 5050) and for transporting Licklider Transmission Protocol (LTP) segments (RFC 5326). It is an Experimental specification.

eli5.summary: Some networks are like mail sent by a slow boat with long gaps in service. This explains how to pack that special mail into ordinary Internet packets so it can travel.
